notes.title: News From Acaristan!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Comrades![/b][/h2][p] The summer season has come to an end, but the Party has not been idle. During this time, we’ve been hard at work preparing a range of improvements that will enhance your experience at the border post! [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Optimization[/b][/h3][p]Over the past few months, we’ve been focusing on the console version of the game. As a result, we’re introducing the [b]largest optimization update to date[/b], featuring a fully custom animation system. This overhaul significantly improves performance, especially during gameplay involving large numbers of NPCs. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/994ec3701e55fe7ceffa7dbe43a10939e263b280.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Console Version Status[/b][/h3][p]The game has successfully passed our internal testing and will be sent for [b]certification next week[/b]. We’ll announce the exact release date in a separate post – stay tuned! [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Docking Station Support[/b][/h3][p]Your strong interest in Steam Deck has not gone unnoticed. We’ve implemented support for the Docking Station, allowing for seamless [b]gameplay with either a keyboard or a gamepad[/b]. No matter your setup – your checkpoint is ready for duty! [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Update 10.7.3[/b][/h3][p]This update introduces a completely new animation system that greatly enhances performance and gameplay speed. We’ve also fixed a number of the most troublesome bugs and implemented improvements based on your feedback to make your service at the border even more satisfying.

Long live Acaristan!
Crazy Rocks Team[/p]

notes.title: Steam Deck Verified
notes.content: [h2][b]Comrades![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that as a result of the Party’s recent efforts, [b]Contraband Police now has full support for the Steam Deck![/b] From now on, officers serving away from their posts can continue defending the borders of Acaristan![/p][p]The list of changes we've implemented is quite extensive — here are the most important ones:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Documents[/b][/h3][p]We’ve introduced a [b]magnifying glass system[/b] that lets you zoom in on documents for better inspection.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/7374bfab3002c9f3760635335934ee528fad5150.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Duty Handbook[/b][/h3][p]Using the handbook is now much clearer — it can now be opened across the full width of the Duty Folder.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/35d9ab0bbd5344e673b40a5e4cee1cec1e6777f1.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Update 10.7.0[/b][/h3][p]In this update, we’ve introduced minor controller handling adjustments in preparation for the upcoming console release. We also fixed several player-reported issues related to inspections and shootouts.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and suggestions — as always, we could count on you to help us improve the game![/p][p][/p][p]Glory to Acaristan![/p][p]Crazy Rocks Team[/p]

notes.title: Holiday Update!
notes.content: [h2][b]Comrades![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Summer has fully settled in, bringing with it increased traffic at the borders of Acaristan. To help you meet this challenge, the Party has prepared a [b]solid package of improvements[/b] to make your duty more efficient and enjoyable![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Larger Inventory[/b][/h3][p]All border guards are now equipped with backpacks that allow them to [b]carry even more contraband and personal gear[/b]. To expand your inventory, upgrade your quarters via the office computer.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/6c790688bb80cd4237fd841bbfe54e08bd4d88a2.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Loot Bags[/b][/h3][p]A new trend has taken Acaristan by storm! Handy carry bags for belongings have flooded the market. After some improvements by the manufacturer, they’re now seen not only with civilians and police officers but also among members of criminal organizations.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/11c8cc870aa3ff51e43f896435c9fa55b4bfdf1a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Your Suggestions[/b][/h3][p]Thanks to the cooperation between the Minister of Defense and active Border Guard members, a number of quality-of-life improvements have been implemented. Key updates include the ability to adjust police siren volume, adjust UV flashlight color, modify the frequency of road ambushes and easier interaction for many objects.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/b6608e3c93f3deb08ca25b4997ea20e40d41a45e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Steam Deck Development[/b][/h3][p]To ensure the best possible Contraband Police experience on Steam Deck, we've prepared numerous improvements to font readability, optimization, and game stability. [b]The game is currently undergoing Steam certification[/b] – as soon as we receive a response, we’ll inform you in a separate announcement. All future updates will also be fully compatible with Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/befa70b33aacee45a25beab15d2e9fa33653407a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Patch 10.6.5[/b][/h3][p]The most important changes in this version include improvements to the body-looting system, better visibility of office computer panels, and the introduction of scalable inventory. We’ve also added many of your requested enhancements and fixed bugs from version 10.6.4.[/p][p][/p][p]Wishing you a peaceful duty and a relaxing holiday![/p][p]Crazy Rocks Team[/p]

notes.title: Spring Update!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Comrades![/b][/h2]

By order of the Party, the following is hereby announced:
As of today, [b]Spring Update[/b] goes live, introducing most of the improvements developed during the console porting process. Additionally, this update addresses the most frustrating gameplay issues and community-reported bugs from recent months.

In the near future, you can expect further updates focused on optimization ([i]especially the animation system[/i]) and additional gameplay fixes.

[h3][b]Consoles[/b][/h3]
At this stage, our work is fully focused on implementing the [b]new animation system[/b]. Due to significant game load during any gameplay restart, we were forced to replace the existing system with our proprietary solution, designed to ensure full stability across all platforms.

Full testing of the finished system will begin later this month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/93413c0d4b5ddb91859b6a4b73848d3f8355d826.png[/img]

[h3][b]Update 10.6.3[/b][/h3]
This version brings significant improvements to game stability and [b]location loading times[/b]. In addition, we’ve implemented over 100 fixes addressing the most common bugs and incorporating your feedback and suggestions.

[h3][b]Crimson Fall[/b][/h3]
Thank you for the overwhelmingly positive reception of our trailer! Your support gives us great motivation to continue working on Contraband Police. Alongside the console porting efforts, our art team is busy creating new terrain and locations.

As a teaser, we present the entrance to the new police station, serving as the Police Base from the basic version of the game. More information about the upcoming DLC will be shared in a separate announcement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/8fe90e04bc023eb69dd6ecac678ee91b61a315b5.png[/img]

Glory to Acaristan!
Crazy Rocks Team

notes.title: 1 Million Copies Sold!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Comrades![/b][/h2]

We are proud to announce that [b]Contraband Police has surpassed the incredible milestone of 1 million copies sold on Steam![/b] This is a massive achievement and a shared success. Your support and feedback are invaluable to us, and we have no intention of resting on our laurels. In the spirit of progress, we’re bringing you a new update packed with significant gameplay changes!

[h3][b]Optimization[/b][/h3]
Comrades, our hard work on optimization has paid off! We’ve improved the game’s performance, resulting in up to 20 additional frames per second! The game now runs smoother than ever, even on less powerful machines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/bbd46b0a58a2234e2450ade3608e78eea37d5243.png[/img]

We haven’t forgotten about your driving experiences. With numerous tweaks, vehicle controls are now more intuitive and realistic. From now on, enjoy every mile you travel on the roads of Acaristan!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/f30759f9f3254f15881c3a1b2480f21a248eebf5.png[/img]

The latest update brings significant improvements to weapon mechanics. Your favorite firearms now feel more dynamic, delivering a true sense of impact. With realistic recoil, inertia, and enhanced sound effects, every battle will have a completely new level of intensity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/9535ae1de101fd7cd6f0f3b2e1cd999a8580d356.png[/img]

Enemies have become smarter! We’ve introduced a new mechanic allowing foes to take advantage of their surroundings. They can now hide behind trees and other objects, making them harder to detect in the field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/46a85ca19150de0b614cb1294cabe03d92358c0b.png[/img]

[h3][b]Console Release[/b][/h3]
The main development work is complete, and as soon as we’re confident the game meets our quality standards, we’ll announce the exact release date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/93413c0d4b5ddb91859b6a4b73848d3f8355d826.png[/img]

[h3][b]Update 10.6.0[/b][/h3]
In this version, we’ve fixed the most troublesome bugs affecting gameplay and mechanics. Additionally, we’ve polished several details to enhance the overall experience.

Comrades, thank you for your support and dedication, which has brought us this far! We’re preparing a major announcement that will detail the future development plans for Contraband Police. Stay ready, as the future promises to be exciting!

Glory to Acaristan!
Crazy Rocks Team

notes.content:

Crazy Rocks Team

notes.title: Plans for the future!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Comrades![/b][/h3]

Due to the very positive reception of [b]Contraband Police[/b] worldwide, we have decided to further develop our creation!

Immediately after the game's release in March last year, we began working on two free expansions: [b]Endless Mode[/b] and [b]Challenge Mode[/b], which significantly expanded the game with new objects and mechanics.

[b]In December 2023, we organized the first contest with prizes![/b]
We made every effort to ensure that the prizes were of the highest quality. Currently, we are in the process of sending them to the winners.
Additionally, seeing a great interest in collectible items, we are considering opening an online store on [url=https://www.crazyrocksstudios.com]our website[/url] where you will be able to order Contraband Police figurines, paintings, and other gadgets. Please write in the comments what you think about this idea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/973897f278b7a2c902652cdf330d6e13560bd8a9.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]We are releasing a free Anniversary Update on March 21, 2024![/b][/h3]
To celebrate this important moment with you, we are preparing new free content!

The AI system is currently undergoing significant changes aimed at improving combat experiences and increasing NPC interaction levels.

Changes include:
[list]
[*] The ability to use hired policemen to help in shootouts. Additionally, each comrade will gradually reveal more fragments of their story.
[*] From now on, unmasked smugglers will attempt to flee on foot. Stop them at all costs and bring them to the arrest, bound in handcuffs.
[*] Neutral NPCs will panic in response to danger on the road and in locations.
[*] Ambush enemies will continue to pursue the player and engage in shootouts with policemen.
[*] The combat system will be expanded with new animations, shouts, and enemy movement mechanics.
[/list]
Here you will find a short report from the last motion capture session.
[previewyoutube=7lLemc2esrI;full][/previewyoutube]
Furthermore, a new vehicle will be available in the game: [b]Sina[/b]. The car has variants for transporting people and goods. The authorities of Acaristan have also made it available to police units!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/f2206b01e202eab852d11668a86544f49d35fa46.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/f5655887c674465ec1444819dfc9fa72f0f405fb.png[/img]
A new weapon will also be introduced: [b]Sniper Rifle with a scope[/b]. The weapon will be further enhanced with a bullet camera system, allowing even greater enjoyment of accurately fired shots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/bde34e828a64fc9d61ea8b3c1041549c7fdd137c.png[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/25cfe522651cfdebb8211714bdad4d98b58814f2.png[/img]
[h3][b]After the anniversary update is released, we plan to continue developing the game.[/b][/h3]
By the end of 2024, we want to continue supporting the game technically and introduce a series of free add-ons including new items, weapons, and vehicles.

Additionally, work is underway to change the game rendering technology ([b]Unity HDRP[/b]), aimed at significantly improving visual effects such as: terrain detail, glass display, lighting, shadow quality, and anti-aliasing.

We also inform you about ongoing porting work for next-generation consoles (PS5, Xbox Series), Meta Quest VR, and mobile devices. Work is going very well, and in just a few months, you can expect the game to be released.

In the longer term, we also plan to start working on another project, which we will inform you about in due course.

[h3][b]Crazy Rocks is growing![/b][/h3]
Three new people are joining our team: Gabriela, Maciej, and Adrian, who will bring new skills, ideas, and energy to the project. Already in March of this year, we are moving to a new, larger office where we will be able to work even more efficiently on Contraband Police!

We can say with full conviction that the game you love is today much richer in content and possibilities than on the day of its debut. To continue this passion and dedication in further support and development, we are faced with the necessity of raising the game's price.
[b]The change will take effect on February 4, 2024.[/b] We understand that the price is important to each of you, and we would like to ensure that this decision is not made without deep consideration. This change reflects the work, time, and love we put into creating every aspect of the game. It is also an investment in the future - thanks to it, we will be able to offer even more free updates and improve gaming experiences for all players.

Best regards,
Crazy Rocks Team

After the success of Contraband Police, we decided not to slow down. ːsteamhappyː To repay your great appreciation, we've created additional game mode that significantly expands the game.

[b]Inspector Mode[/b], a.k.a the Endless Mode, was created for players who prefer greater gameplay freedom and further options for expanding their outpost. Sudden forced interventions, player rest and movement area restrictions have been removed.

In the new mode, we take on the role of Nikola Roznikov, the previous commander of the border crossing in Karikatka, who was entrusted with the task of rebuilding the ruined post.

[*]Unlimited gameplay time.

[*]2 new police cars: Micros and Varilla.
[*]25 new Steam achievements to earn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/31151070b4881415d6d7d718684100289f2ee4a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/3646de812f55d06320d5215a5622afc2e63140eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/64d69a8fc8b0ca05aaef928b331bc383bac31973.png[/img]

[h2]Weapons & Combat[/h2]
We now have a total of 5 different firearms also used by NPCs: Pistol, Shotgun, Submachinegun, Rifle and Sniper Rifle. We also added an aiming option for player (RMB).
Our allies and opponents use the Cover System, but at certain times they can still rush and even attack melee at close range.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/841ed4b05391323dcae4b76dac54ce07c6ba97b1.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/bac48b838a53392764514bd03b7f87ac8f84e677.png[/img]


[h2]Post Management[/h2]
The only expenses during the Prologue were purchases from Vlad and the daily costs of maintaining the outpost. There was also a mention of expanding the warehouse and that was it...
The computer at the office allows you to find out about the daily costs, hire staff, upgrade buildings and buy new vehicles!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/e3d2cf0f0dd6238ed35410434793d0306f2fde5b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/896af33f733e7898ce4d1827027842f0e82cd45f.png[/img]

If you think that the border crossing in Karikatka is a peaceful place, you are wrong. Your outpost can be attacked without a warning by Blood Fist rebel groups and the Smugglers Gang.
Hire additional policemen to help repel the attacks.
Over time, these attacks will become more and more dangerous. Upgrade your staff to increase your chances of survival.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/f1fd2e8b0ab1e69ce31e37e0f859bb5c3854f31a.png[/img]

A good job deserves a reward and a little luxury. Upgrade your quarters to gain more health and perception points needed to check documents.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/e9333c0c591d48d43d64720a0f262005c7e3c6a2.png[/img]

In time you will need new police cars. Each has it's unique destiny: Zaved may be the best option for fast pursiuts while Grazduk can transport multiple prisoners at once.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/4400ec43d95b77275c4c86240f3863aac4c3a5ed.png[/img]

[h2]Country Events[/h2]
During the game, you will receive various regulations from the Ministry of Transport regarding the admission rules.
They are related to important events in Acaristan, such as: Conflict of States, Economic Boom or Pandemic. 
During some events, drivers will be required to have additional documents, such as a vaccination card.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/9435a3b7a02ac96a1154320d44463e3c745dd676.png[/img]

[h2]Ordering Transport[/h2]
Running out of tools or magazine space? The prison is overcrowded and you don't feel like going for a ride? 
From today, for a certain fee, you can call Vlad or one-time police transport!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/472482f68c06ca95619371ecbd31ef6e2e154f93.png[/img]

[h2]Searching For Contraband[/h2]
The information board will still provide you with clues about possible smugglers, but you also need to look for the Smuggler Markers on the parts.
There are several types of markers, and they are quite hard to spot. As the game progresses, there will be more and more smugglers, but they will be harder to spot!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31255534/667c39ab2be4de5f5271709d518e35ff19fa165f.png[/img]

We are currently working on refining all locations and we are putting together story missions. 
The last thing I want is to spoil the plot, so I will just say that there will be some shootings, some detective work and you can complete each mission in 2 different ways and reveal other possible endings of the game!

Stay tuned for more interesting News From Acaristan!

Cheers,
Stan & CrazyRocks Team

notes.title: Development Update #5
notes.content:

notes.title: Development Update #3
notes.content:
In Contraband Police drivers can carry various cargo.
There are several groups of cargo including: Animals, Food, Households, Chemicals, Building Materials and Luggage.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/cargo_hold.png[/img]

To legally transport cargo to Acaristan, driver must have a valid transport document.
It is your responsibility to check the compliance of the vehicle cargo with the transport document declaration.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/cargo_list.png[/img]

The transport of some cargo may be prohibited on a given day - be alert to mission guidelines.
Cargo objects can be easily counted using a cargo notebook. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/cargo1_00000.gif[/img]

You can also move individual objects from vehicle to the inspection area. This way you can discover cargo that is hidden deeper in the car.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/cargo2_00000.gif[/img]

Every cargo may additionally contain a hidden contraband!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/cargo3_00000.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for next updates,

Cheers !

notes.title: Development Update #2
notes.content:
[b]Dear fans![/b]

Today I'd like to present you our unique system MIV™ (Movement Inside Vehicle) which is part of the overall Contraband Police vehicle system.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/gif2_00000.gif[/img]

[b]Getting into vehicles has never been so natural![/b]
Just open door and walk towards the seat - you'll be automatically pulled to it.
While being inside, you can look around normally and change between possible seats using standard movement keys.

In some cases, you will be pulled into the vehicle and continue to move freely (see the movie below)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/gif3_00000.gif[/img]

There is a special UI indicator (bottom-left corner) that shows your current position and possible transitions (red transitions are blocked e.g. due to closed door)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/miv_ui.png[/img]

As you can see MIV™ allows us not only to search vehicle interior for contraband but also to drive away quickly.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/gif1_00000.gif[/img]

I really hope, you'll like it !

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello everyone !![/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/24h_650_00000.gif[/img]

We apologize you guys for the lack of contact so far.

Our game has undergone a lot of changes and we decided to wait with 
the disclosure of development details until core gameplay was stabilized..

From now on we promise to post regular updates on our progress and also we 
will show you some nice features that are already implemented.

-----------

[b]Let me start with a few words about our item system ![/b]

In Contraband Police we have a grid inventory UI to easly move items between hand and backpack.
Every Item in game can be hold in hand no matter if it's a tool or some other stuff. 
Item from hand can be used, dropped or thrown. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/inventory.png[/img]

One of major item type is a TOOL. There are 5 different tool classes that are used mainly for contraband search:
[list][*]Blades
[*]Blunts
[*]Axes
[*]Shovel
[*]Pitchfork
[/list]
Each class is best against certain contraband hiding spots.
E.g. Blades are perfect for cutting upholstery or tires while Axes can make holes in metal canisters or other hard surfaces.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/756800/extras/basic_tool.png[/img]

Stay tuned for next update !!
